item.title: Good schools don’t beat staff turnover. They’re built for it
item.description: High-performing schools often fade because success depends on specific leaders or staff, not durable systems. item.title: California schools with low vaccination rates lose millions of dollars
item.description: California schools lost more than $2.2 million in state funding over two years due to student vaccination noncompliance, state data show. Last year, 428 schools with low vaccination rates were flagged for state audits. The post California schools with low vaccination rates lose millions of dollars appeared first on District Administration.

item.title: Texas education board approves 4,200 corrections in Bible-infused curriculum
item.description: Texas education board members approved about 4,200 fixes to the state’s Bluebonnet curriculum after raising concerns about errors and oversight. The Texas Education Agency says taxpayers will cover the changes as updated materials roll out online and in print. item.title: Houston ISD board votes to close 12 schools, angering audience at meeting
item.description: Houston ISD’s state-appointed board voted unanimously to close 12 schools, prompting backlash from parents and officials who criticized the lack of community input. District leaders cited declining enrollment and aging facilities as the reason for the closures. item.title: Virginia lawmakers propose guardrails for artificial intelligence use in education
item.description: As Virginia schools adopt AI and students spend more time on screens, state lawmakers question the technology’s impact on students’ safety, critical thinking and learning skills. item.title: School districts can set aside prayer time under a new Texas law. Few have done so
item.description: Most Texas school districts have declined a new state-approved opportunity to set aside time each day for students and staff to pray before school. So far, only 15 districts have opted into the voluntary prayer period, while many urban, suburban and rural districts have voted against it. item.title: Study finds screen time negatively correlates with child vocabulary
item.description: In a survey of over 460 caregivers of children ages 17-30 months about word use and video consumption, Southern Methodist University found that spending less time with digital media was linked to higher vocabulary scores. item.title: Supreme Court blocks California law against schools outing transgender students to parents
item.description: The Supreme Court cleared the way for California schools to tell religious parents if their children identify as transgender without getting the student's approval, granting an emergency appeal from a conservative legal group. item.title: Schools are using AI counselors to track students’ mental health. Is it safe?
item.description: Some schools are turning to AI chat platforms that flag student messages for potential self-harm or other safety risks. Experts say the tools may help short-staffed districts triage concerns, but warn they can’t replace human judgment and raise privacy concerns. item.title: NTSB says Waymo robotaxis illegally passed stopped school buses in new incidents
item.description: The National Transportation Safety Board is investigating a new incident of Waymo self-driving vehicles passing a stopped school bus with its ‌lights activated.
